title: HAX properties locale overlay
description: Translation overlay stored as `locales/<tag>.<lang>.haxProperties.json` next to an element. HaxStore.attemptGizmoTranslation merges it over the base haxProperties: `gizmo` keys are replaced; each `settings.configure` / `settings.advanced` entry that names its field with `property`, `attribute` or `slot` is applied to that field, and entries without one are applied to the field at the same array index. Naming the field is recommended: reordering the base file then cannot mislabel translations. `demoSchema` entries merge by index. `settings.developer` is not translated.

properties.description: Translated user-visible property values, keyed like the base demo.

translatedFields.description: Entries that name their field (`property` / `attribute` / `slot`) can be in any order; entries without one must line up by index with the base group.

property.description: Identifies the base field to translate (not copied).

attribute.description: Identifies the base field to translate (not copied).

slot.description: Identifies the base field to translate (not copied).
